model_output.verdict: Your move from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply is a good progression. I’d hesitate to move the resume forward because the accounting work is listed mostly as duties. What part of the close is yours?
write_up: You’ve moved from accounts payable into a Staff Accountant role at Rivermark Building Supply, with close, reconciliation, audit and fixed asset work. It’s common for accounting resumes to list duties this way, but yours won’t stand out in a pile until a recruiter can see more of what you handle and how much.

The journal entries and account reconciliations line is the best model because it names two deliverables rather than just a responsibility. Your progression and dates are easy to follow, and your accounting degree and tools sit where a recruiter can find them.

Let’s start with the month-end close line, then add the accounts, volume or deliverables you can substantiate under the other Staff Accountant lines. A short description of Rivermark’s business would also give a recruiter context for your work.

cards.line: The resume doesn't say how large Rivermark Building Supply is.
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter may not know the business, so it's difficult to place your accounting work in context.
cards.example: Rivermark Building Supply, Sacramento, CA | [business size or operations]
cards.question: How would you describe the business and its size?

cards.cannot_tell: Month-end close covers a lot of work. A recruiter can't tell which tasks are yours or what accounts they touch.
cards.example: Responsible for month-end close tasks, including [tasks] for [accounts or entities]
cards.question: Which close tasks do you handle, and which accounts or entities do they cover?

cards.line: - Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations
cards.cannot_tell: This names the work, but not the accounts or how often you prepare the entries and reconciliations.
cards.example: Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations for [accounts] each [period]
cards.question: Which accounts do you handle, and how often do you prepare the entries and reconciliations?

cards.cannot_tell: Assist could mean several things. The recruiter can't see what you contribute to the audit.
cards.example: Assist with the annual audit by [audit work]
cards.question: What work do you do for the annual audit?

cards.cannot_tell: The schedules are a useful deliverable, but the line doesn't say which assets they cover or what maintaining them involves.
cards.example: Maintain fixed asset schedules for [assets], including [schedule work]
cards.question: Which assets do the schedules cover, and what work do you do on them?

cards.cannot_tell: Your earlier role shows accounts payable experience, but this line doesn't say what you handle in the Staff Accountant job or how often.
cards.example: Process accounts payable when needed, including [payables work] at [frequency]
cards.question: What accounts payable work do you handle in this role, and how often?

fit.why: Your headline and current role both name Staff Accountant, and your work includes close, journal entries and reconciliations.
fit.level: mid-level, progressed from accounts payable to month-end close and reconciliations
fit.note: Your experience points toward staff accounting roles that combine close and reconciliation work. Your QuickBooks, NetSuite and Excel skills give a recruiter useful tools to look for alongside that work.
